acceptance.given: A replay result is produced or recorded with a candidate Current Snapshot manifest.

oracle.expected: Replay result records binding to a complete Current Snapshot whose identity and contents match the replay inputs.
forbidden: A replay result is unbound from a Current Snapshot.
oracle.observable: Replay validation reports snapshot_binding.present=true, snapshot_complete=true, and matching snapshot identity.

acceptance.then: The replay result is associated with a complete Current Snapshot.
acceptance.when: When a replay result is produced or recorded.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute replay validation with the snapshot binding removed or a required snapshot member omitted; it must fail closed and identify the missing or incomplete Current Snapshot binding.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure every replay result is serialized and validated against a complete Current Snapshot, rejecting absent or incomplete manifests.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay result fields while requiring complete snapshot binding and fail-closed validation.

slice_hint.state_transition: unbound_or_incomplete replay result -> result bound to a complete Current Snapshot
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation passes only when snapshot binding is present, complete, and identity-matching; otherwise deterministic failure is emitted.

acceptance.given: An aggregate evaluation is supplied matrix evidence with one or more required matrix cases absent.

oracle.expected: Aggregate status is invalid and the validator reports missing required matrix evidence.
forbidden: The aggregate is treated as valid despite missing matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: Aggregate result contains status=invalid and a missing_matrix_evidence diagnostic naming absent cases.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run aggregate evaluation with a required matrix case omitted; validator must return invalid rather than green.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Aggregate evaluation checks required matrix-case completeness and invalidates the aggregate whenever any required case is absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep aggregate result schema stable while adding deterministic invalid status and missing-case diagnostics.

slice_hint.state_transition: aggregate evaluating incomplete matrix -> invalid aggregate with explicit missing-case diagnostic
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate is valid only if every required matrix case has attributable evidence; any missing case yields invalid status.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result is marked successful and includes target identity data.

oracle.expected: Successful Replay Result contains an independent target verification record matching the declared target and evaluated separately from replay success.
forbidden: The target is not independently verified by the successful Replay Result.
oracle.observable: Validation reports target_verification.independent=true and verified_target_identity equal to declared target identity.

acceptance.then: The target is independently verified by the successful Replay Result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Provide a successful replay result with absent, mismatched, or replay-coupled target verification; validator must reject success because independent target verification is missing.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Successful replay results independently verify and record target identity, rejecting mismatches or coupled-only checks.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing target fields and add independent verification metadata for valid results.

slice_hint.state_transition: successful result lacking independent target proof -> independently verified success or deterministic rejection
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Success is terminal only when independent target verification passes and verified identity matches the declared target.

acceptance.given: An aggregate evaluation contains matrix evidence whose target identity differs from the aggregate subject.

oracle.expected: Aggregate status is invalid and diagnostics identify wrong-target matrix evidence.
forbidden: The aggregate is treated as valid despite wrong-target matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: Aggregate result contains status=invalid and a wrong_target_matrix_evidence diagnostic with expected and observed target identities.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run aggregate evaluation with matrix evidence bound to a different target identity; validator must invalidate the aggregate and report the mismatch.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Aggregate evaluation verifies each matrix evidence target identity against the aggregate subject and invalidates any mismatch.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve aggregate schema while adding deterministic wrong-target diagnostics and invalid status.

slice_hint.state_transition: aggregate with mismatched matrix target -> invalid aggregate with target mismatch diagnostic
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate is valid only when every matrix evidence target identity equals the aggregate subject identity; mismatch yields invalid status.
